author: Matt Wolfe
description:
Here are 3 things EVERY business owner should automate with AI:

1️⃣ Checking failed email deliveries. 
2️⃣ Sending appointment reminders
3️⃣ Getting new customers set up

All of these small tasks add up, so don't waste your time doing them manually.

Bird lets you build workflows where AI agents handle more of that repetitive work, while you decide what still needs your review.

If you’re figuring out where to start with AI in your business, start with the stuff you’re tired of doing yourself every day.

And to check out Bird, head to bird.com or the link in the pinned comment.

title: 3 Critical Tasks AI Can Automate For You
